name: Spell Learn Spell
description: Additional spells that are automatically learned when a player learns the trigger spell (and unlearned when it is removed). Complements the learn-spell effects already present in Spell.dbc; talent spells are not allowed as learned spells.

fields.name: Spell
fields.help: Spell which, when learned, also teaches the learned spell

fields.name: Active
fields.help: If 1 the learned spell is shown in the spellbook, if 0 it is learned as a hidden/passive spell
